Paper: p. 62 (one domain 0 < q < q_big), p. 64 (active part A_l, labels l >= l_0 in (6.8)), p. 65 (partition identity on the active shell), p. 111 and p. 114 (q_* = q_big). Read, not compiled.

The three contents of the corollary are all stated in Lean, in free exponents: the exact four-term expansion (CorrectionStep.lean:2309/2313), the remainder class bounds with exactly δ+β = ρ+α−1/2, α+η = α+1/2−κ_s, 2β = 2α−1 and κ_s < 1/2 appearing as β ≤ η (:2366, assembled at :3214), and the κ-loss of the radial divergence (MeanIncrementBounds.lean:287). The two deviations — Σ left as B(W0^as,L^asΣ), and the three bounds conjoined into one minimum — are recovered by instantiating and conjoining stated general declarations, so by the logic-alone rule the verdict is OK and both are low attribution gaps. Lean is in fact more general: U's, the tangent's and the curl's exponents stay free, and divergence-freeness is not assumed.

findings.summary: (7.42)'s three separate memberships are never stated together; Lean states one bound on the sum at γ ≤ min(δ+β, α+η, 2β). Each separate bound is an instantiation of a stated general product rule, so this is packaging, not content.

The Lean split keeps the cross term as B(W0^as, L^asΣ) instead of Σ. Its identification with Σ is stated for arbitrary Σ only at the native-assembly level; at the level of the assembled fields of the split it is stated only for the pipeline's requested stress.

The ruling's route for the Sigma substitution (NativeData.requested_cross, native_family_cross) cannot be instantiated on the repository's actual chart: SignedMeanGain.NativeData is proved empty for ActualInitialization.geometry and is constructed nowhere in NavierStokes/. The identity that applies to the actual fields is ActualSignedMeanBinding.requested_cross_factor. For a general Sigma it is recovered only by repeating four stated proof bodies with an arbitrary request.

On the actual chart the stated cross identity carries a partition factor: meanBar(cross) = partitionFactor * Sigma at every band. The only named exact form (requested_cross_tail) is restricted to bands n >= N+1. The paper's domain q < q_big <= 2^{-l_0} corresponds to physicalScale n x <= Q N (reading l_0 as (choice B N0).prepared.N), which also includes band N with coordinateQ <= 1; exactness there needs the two-step combination requested_cross_factor + partitionFactor_eq_one. Lean's chart also covers q up to 2 (bands n < N and the upper half of band N), which the paper does not treat; there the cross is (1 - missingWeight) * Sigma.
